subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 1: revises Term 3 sounds; /j/ (jog, jam, jug, jet); sound differentiation; rhyming; claps syllables in names

show.line: Listen. j, j, jam. j, j, jug! Jam starts with j.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with j, as in jam?
Say the sound with me. j, as in jet!
Listen. j, o, g. What word is it?
Clap the name Thandi. Than, di. How many claps?
Does it start with j or g? Sort the pictures.

hints: j sounds like the start of jump. j, j, j.
Clap for each part of the name.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. j, e, t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! j, e, t makes jet.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. j, e, t. Jet!

parent_line: Can hear the j sound and blend words like jog, jam and jet.
